issue.title: Convert jars paths in class-path manifest to be url-encoded

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
This PR converts the paths in the Class-Path attribute of MANIFEST.MF to be URL-encoded. If a special character such as '%' is not encoded, then Java will not find the jar and this results in NoClassDefFoundError.

Fixes: #10620
